info.name: SF-506 - Estimated Onboarding Date Field Mapping - API Tests
info.description:
API - SF-506 - Hide Estimated Onboarding Date on Account and Map from Lead to Opportunity

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Generated: 2026-01-18
Updated: Fixed SOQL query definitions
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

SUMMARY:
  Hide Estimated Onboarding Date on Account and Map from Lead to Opportunity

DESCRIPTION:
  As an MRD I want the Estimated Onboarding Date field to be hidden from all 
  Account page layouts So that it is only used during the Lead-to-Opportunity 
  process and not visible or editable once the Account is created, while still 
  ensuring the value carries over automatically from Lead to Opportunity.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
  1. Estimated Onboarding Date hidden from all Account page layouts
  2. Estimated Onboarding Date maps from Lead to Opportunity
  3. No mapping to Account during conversion

API TESTING REQUIREMENTS:
  - Verify Estimated_Onboarding_Date__c field exists on Opportunity and Account
  - Verify field maps from Lead to Opportunity during conversion
  - Verify field does NOT map to Account during conversion
  - Verify field value is preserved during Lead conversion
  - Negative/boundary scenarios

Generated from: src/features/api/SF/SF-506.feature

This collection contains API tests for SF-506 work item.

QUERY FORMAT NOTES:
  - Single record retrieval: GET /sobjects/{object}/{id}?fields=...
  - SOQL queries: GET /query?q=SELECT... (URL-encoded)
  - All queries properly formatted for Postman import
